newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schering expects net profit up 34 pct in 96.
newsitem.headline: Schering expects net profit up 34 pct in 96.

text.p: German drugs group Schering AG said on Monday it expects its full-year 1996 net profit figure to show an increase of 34 percent.
"We expect to be able to achieve a 34 percent increase for the entire year," Schering's chief financial officer Klaus Pohle told a news conference.

Pohle said that the nine-month net profit figure on an adjusted basis would have shown a 34 percent increase and that the 66 percent increase actually shown was largely due to an unusually low comparison in the first nine months of 1995.
Schering said nine month profits were 286 million marks ($190.2 million) compared with 172 million marks in the previous year.
